description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for handling strings validated against a regular expression within the OpenMRS framework. It includes methods for setting the regex configuration, serializing/deserializing values, and validating input strings.

classes.name: RegexValidatedTextDatatype
classes.description: A datatype class for strings validated against a regex, extending SerializingCustomDatatype for serialization and validation within OpenMRS.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the regex pattern used for validation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the string value; in this case, returns the input directly.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the string value; in this case, returns the input directly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input string matches the configured regex pattern, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the regex pattern for validation based on the provided regex string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns the string value as-is for serialization.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Returns the input string as-is for deserialization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input string matches the regex pattern and throws an exception if validation fails.
